newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Woolworths 53 week sales A$15.57 billion.
newsitem.headline: Woolworths 53 week sales A$15.57 billion.

text.p: Retailer Woolworths Ltd said on Thursday that sales for the 53 weeks to June 29 were A$15.57 billion, up 11.36 percent on the previous corresponding period.
Sales for the 13 weeks to June 29 were A$3.78 billion, up 18.37 percent on the previous corresponding period.

Fifty-three week sales from the food division were A$13.35 billion, an increase of 11.33 percent on the previous corresponding period, while general merchandise posted a 12.41 percent increase to A$1.82 billion.
Specialty retail sales for the 53 weeks rose 7.6 percent to A$396 million.
The previous corresponding period covered 52 weeks ended June 23, 1996.
Woolworths said the overall sales result was satisfactory in a competitive and difficult retail environment.

The results reflected a continued improvement in sales trend for the food group and a strong customer response to pricing policy in the general merchandise group, both of which increased market share, Woolworths said.

After adjusting for the timing difference of Easter trading (between the third and fourth quarter comparatives) and excluding the additional weeks trading in the latest year, the rate of sales growth for each quarter in the financial year continued to trend upwards, the retail group said.
